stem: A drone hovers directly above a point \(P\) on a flat cricket ground in Colombo. From a camera at point \(Q\) on the ground, 90 meters from \(P\), the angle of elevation of the drone is \(34^{\circ}\). The drone then rises straight up until the angle of elevation from \(Q\) is \(52^{\circ}\). To the nearest meter, how far did the drone rise?

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is \(90 \tan 18^{\circ}\), using the difference of the angles. Tangent is not linear, so the heights must be found separately and then subtracted.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the drone's height before it rose, \(90 \tan 34^{\circ}\), not the change in height.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the drone's final height, \(90 \tan 52^{\circ}\), not how far it rose.

verify:
h1=90*tan(34*pi/180); h2=90*tan(52*pi/180)
ans=N(h2-h1)
assert abs(ans-54.49)<0.01
assert abs(value(choices[answer])-ans)<0.5
assert all(abs(value(choices[k])-ans)>0.5 for k in choices if k!=answer)
assert abs(value(choices['C'])-h1)<0.5 and abs(value(choices['D'])-h2)<0.5 and abs(value(choices['A'])-90*tan(18*pi/180))<0.5
